speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass. To begin our assessment, how old are you, and for how long have you been experiencing the bleeding?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial hyperplasia or endometrial carcinoma (postmenopausal bleeding with adnexal mass). I am ordering a pelvic ultrasound to evaluate the endometrial thickness and characterize the adnexal mass, along with a CA-125 tumor marker.
